title: wb git push refuses every branch wb flow start created
desc: flow start --execute runs 'git switch -c <branch> origin/<source>'. With git's default branch.autoSetupMerge that sets the new branch's upstream to origin/<source>, so 'wb git push --execute' then refuses with 'this branch already has an upstream' -- the tool's own start path can never reach its own publish path. Seen on WB-22 (PR #17), pushed by hand. Likely fix: 'git switch --no-track -c', with a regression test on a real checkout.
